neutral.description: Baseline expression: eyes open, brows neutral, mouth closed. The default resting state for the character.

skeptical.description: Dubious or questioning expression: eyes open, brows skeptical (one raised), mouth slightly open. Conveys skepticism or analysis.

deadpan.description: Flat affect, trademark state: eyes half-lidded (using closed layers with opacity/scale tricks), brows neutral, mouth closed. Emotionally flat but attentive.

alarm.description: Sudden realization or concern: eyes open wide, brows raised, mouth slightly open. Conveys surprise or alarm.

notes: Expression library maps character states (expression, eyes, brows) to layer combinations. Eyes: 'open' and 'side_eye' both show open eyes; 'blink' and 'half_lid' both use closed layers (half_lid will need opacity/scale tricks in the renderer until a dedicated half-lid sprite is created). Brows: 'neutral' is the default calm state; 'skeptical' raises one brow (skeptical_l/skeptical_r); 'raised' currently uses neutral layers but is reserved for future raised-brow artwork. Mouths link to production layer IDs: closed, slight_open, open_a, open_e, open_o, smirk, frown.
